description: Single-panel figure labelled (a) that is a selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) spot pattern — not the mechanical-property table its caption ("Table 1") implies, so caption and pixels disagree. The pattern is recorded along the annotated "Zone = [1 0 0]" axis, shown as bright diffraction spots on a black background; the lower-left carries the printed scale annotation "5 1/nm". Two reflections are labelled and ringed with open circles: (0 1 0) at the left and (0 0 1) at the upper right, consistent with a cubic-like reciprocal lattice viewed down [100], with weaker additional reflections visible between the strong ones. No specimen name, composition, rolling reduction, temperature or numerical property value is printed anywhere in the image, so this panel itself carries no mechanical data. The citing text states that Table 1 summarizes the mechanical properties of the studied Fe-Mn-Al-C austenitic low-density steel at different hot-rolling reductions: HR45 (45% reduction) UTS 861 ± 11 MPa, YS 480 ± 0 MPa, TE 60%; HR82 (82% reduction) UTS 976 ± 11 MPa, YS 648 ± 13 MPa; uniform elongation decreasing from 52.0 ± 1.0% to 39.0 ± 0.8% and total elongation from 60 ± 1% to 50 ± 1%, with reduction of area >60% for all three samples. None of these numbers is visible in the supplied pixels.

observations.observation: The supplied image is a single-panel SAED spot pattern (panel label '(a)') on a black background, not a rendered table.
The diffraction pattern is annotated 'Zone = [1 0 0]', i.e. recorded along the [100] zone axis.
A scale annotation printed as '5 1/nm' appears at the lower left of the pattern.
Reflections labelled (0 1 0) (left) and (0 0 1) (upper right) are each marked with an open circle.
Weaker diffraction spots are visible between the strong spots, in addition to the two labelled reflections.
No sample name, composition, rolling reduction or numeric property value is printed anywhere in the supplied image.
The caption of the supplied figure is only 'Table 1', which does not describe the SAED pattern actually shown; caption and pixels disagree.
The citing text states that Table 1 summarizes mechanical properties: HR45 (45% rolling reduction) has UTS 861 ± 11 MPa, YS 480 ± 0 MPa and total elongation 60%.
The citing text states that increasing the rolling reduction from 45% to 82% raises UTS and YS to 976 ± 11 MPa and 648 ± 13 MPa respectively, i.e. improvements of ~110 MPa (UTS) and ~170 MPa (YS).
The citing text states uniform elongation (UE) decreases from 52.0 ± 1.0% to 39.0 ± 0.8% and total elongation (TE) from 60 ± 1% to 50 ± 1% as rolling reduction increases.
The citing text states all three investigated samples possess a similar reduction of area of >60%.
